ask: Copy clean prompts, answers, code, or commands.
plugin: A command extracts unformatted text from local session records and writes it to the clipboard; a function hook can add a copy action to the transcript.

ask: Customize reading order, expansion, scrolling, and response rendering.
plugin: Experimental function hooks change transcript presentation; a command offers paged raw transcript output.

ask: Set prompt, output, diff, icon, and accent colors.
plugin: A theme file or experimental render hook applies user-selected colors to terminal UI regions.

ask: Hide banners, hints, surveys, diffs, indicators, and other visual clutter.
plugin: Function hooks suppress selected interface regions and settings hooks filter configurable status messages.

ask: Customize prompt editing keys and terminal-specific bindings.
plugin: A bin utility configures terminal key sequences; experimental function hooks map incoming keys to composer and menu actions.

ask: Show or edit pasted text instead of collapsing it into a placeholder.
plugin: Experimental function hooks control paste display and offer an expansion action in the composer.

ask: Extend Vim motions, modes, paste, and cursor feedback in the terminal composer.
plugin: Experimental function hooks extend prompt-editor actions and expose mode state to a terminal cursor helper.

ask: Choose a per-project naming scheme for saved plans.
plugin: A skill or hook names saved plan files from project rules and maintains an index of active plans.

ask: Show timestamps and turn attribution in conversation output.
plugin: Function hooks annotate rendered messages or a transcript command adds timestamps to exported sessions.

ask: Dictate prompts with configurable language and vocabulary.
plugin: A local bin speech recognizer or MCP tool transcribes audio and sends it to the prompt; functions hooks add toggle controls.

ask: Configure terminal escape sequences and compatible keybindings.
plugin: A bin installer detects terminal config syntax and installs or explains the required key mappings.

ask: Export, search, and review full conversation transcripts.
plugin: A command or MCP server reads local session records and exports or searches them, including pre-compaction turns.

ask: Customize thinking verbs, duration text, and progress animation.
plugin: Experimental function hooks replace spinner messages and render settings; an output style controls assistant tone.

ask: Accept clipboard images and resize them before sending.
plugin: A bin helper reads platform clipboards, converts formats, compresses oversized images, and attaches prepared files via a command.

ask: Compose and recover long prompts in an external editor.
plugin: A command launches the configured editor, loads the draft, and submits its saved text; a hook can preserve drafts.

ask: Expose additional internal state to custom status lines.
plugin: Experimental function hooks read model, mode, agent, MCP, sandbox, and context state and publish it to a statusline helper.

ask: Name terminal tabs and windows from project, session, or task state.
plugin: A status-line helper emits OSC title sequences and restores the original title on exit.

ask: Queue, schedule, or chain prompts while Claude works.
plugin: A command and monitor maintain a task queue; hooks submit the next prompt after Stop.

ask: Name, label, group, and summarize sessions.
plugin: A command reads session metadata, generates names, and maintains a searchable index; hooks can update names after turns.

ask: Show model, context, cost, git, session, and task state in a custom footer.
plugin: A statusline command formats available session JSON with local git and process data; a monitor refreshes external values.

ask: Show quota, rate-limit, and reset data in the terminal.
plugin: A statusline command reads locally available usage data and displays labeled bars and reset times; unavailable server data is reported as unknown.

ask: Notify when Claude stops, needs input, or finishes a task.
plugin: Notification and Stop hooks drive desktop alerts, bells, or audio with configurable timing.

ask: Find and insert project files with fuzzy, shorthand, or case-aware matching.
plugin: An MCP tool or command indexes project paths and inserts a chosen path; a function hook can replace @ completion.

ask: Display bidirectional and non-Latin text correctly in the terminal.
plugin: Experimental function hooks transform terminal rendering and input layout for supported scripts.

ask: Search prompt history with prefixes, filters, and session scope.
plugin: A function hook indexes submitted prompts and supplies a searchable history action.

ask: Create, preserve, review, and resume plans with user-defined steps.
plugin: A skill and commands save plans, offer revisions, and resume execution from durable plan files.

ask: Present CLI labels, hints, and status messages in the user’s language.
plugin: Experimental function hooks translate TUI labels and prompts, while an output style controls the language of assistant responses.

ask: Read assistant answers aloud.
plugin: A Stop hook or MCP tool sends the latest response to a text-to-speech engine.

ask: Provide screen-reader-friendly, low-motion, high-contrast CLI output.
plugin: An output style and function hooks replace noisy symbols, dense tables, and animation with screen-reader-friendly text.

ask: Add controls and labels to interactive selection dialogs.
plugin: Experimental function hooks change menu actions and labels, including plan and permission choices.

ask: Find slash commands by name, alias, category, or argument.
plugin: A command indexes installed skills and aliases; a function hook can change the native completion menu.

ask: Park and restore unfinished prompts.
plugin: A function hook captures composer text; a command lists and restores saved drafts.

ask: Keep input focus and cursor position visible.
plugin: Experimental function hooks adjust input focus, cursor shape, and placement on terminal events.

ask: Browse and filter sessions or related branches.
plugin: A command presents a searchable session index with IDs, project, branch, and summaries.

ask: See agents and background tasks in a separate live view.
plugin: A monitor reads agent/task events and serves a tree or compact status feed in another terminal.

ask: Select file or image attachments with a shortcut.
plugin: A command opens an external picker and returns paths; function hooks add a key action.

ask: Warn and act before the context window fills.
plugin: A monitor tracks context percentage and a hook warns or invokes a user-selected compact workflow.

ask: Improve a draft prompt before it is submitted.
plugin: A skill reviews and rewrites the draft, then returns it for approval or submission.

ask: Display a distinct short title and description for each skill.
plugin: Experimental function hooks adapt the skill list display while keeping the full skill description for model matching.

ask: Control answer tone, format, and code presentation.
plugin: An output style and command produce concise execution summaries on demand.

ask: Apply repeatable approval rules and provide safer decision controls.
plugin: PreToolUse settings hooks inspect commands and paths, then allow, deny, or ask with a reason.

ask: Control when contextual prompt suggestions appear and how they are accepted.
plugin: Experimental function hooks generate context-aware suggestions and customize acceptance keys and visibility.
